Question: Dear Mufti Saheb, Salam, Mene ek bar ek taqrir me suna tha ke, jis ke dil me rai ke dane ke bara bar ka iman ho ga allah use bhi jannat ada karega, is hadish ke bare me baray maherbani muje tafsil se batayen. Answer ID: 9737 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2608/2099=H/1429) If one shuns from kufr and shirk he will certainly enter Jannah , whether he is granted Jannah just after death or after being punished in Jahannam due to his sins. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
